verdicts.reason: A: the oversized logo badge dominates the canvas. The 'Chase the light' headline is small and left-aligned while the logo and CTA are centred, so the column has no shared axis. Large uneven gaps separate the headline, the subhead and the CTA, which leaves the copy as scattered fragments in dead space, though the brand→headline→CTA order matches the original. B: it has the same mixed left and centre alignment and the same tiny headline and subhead. It moves the logo between the copy and the CTA, which splits the message from its button and groups the CTA with the logo instead. It also leaves big empty bands at the top and bottom, so it is no better and slightly less coherent than A.
